To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the radiation effect on the tumor is not uniform but is characterized by the presence of remissions and recurrences, (2) the tumor remissions are caused by the radiation effect on tumor vessels, and the recurrences are due to the radiation effect on cells, (3) the radiation effect can be influenced by the growth behavior of the tumor and (4) the radiation effect is not only influenced by the dose of radiation, but also by the time factor.
